text_block_list.text:
Т.М. Опера О receives tickets for the
amusement
park and invites me to come.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Hark... Who among us should rejoice?
Yourself?
Or the attractions?
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: Yes, the attractions! It should come as a supreme delight that I, the Overlord, am present to enjoy them.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Exuberant swans treading through the
waters
might take flight! Spinning tea
cups may quicken
into a cyclone of
sheer jubilation!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О
choice_data_list: You don't think that sounds dangerous?

text_block_list.text:
Ohh, not to worry! I will manage should
it come to
that.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Tarry not. Why don't we begin with the
ride most
near?
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
We head into the building of the nearest

attraction, but then...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Hyeee! S-stop, please! This mustn't...
Ahhh!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
How terrific! And in every sense of the
word!
Trainer... save yourself!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: Ack!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Т.М. Опера О falls to her knees. I rush
over and
help her out of the building.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: ...I apologize for losing my composure.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Never had I imagined... that within such
an
enclosure there would be...
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Mirrors upon cascading mirrors ad
infinitum!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: So that is a "house of mirrors"... My own brilliance nearly blinded me!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
And you, Trainer, to be surrounded by
such
multiplicities of myself... I must
apologize!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: Your eyes... Were they not damaged?
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: She seems genuinely concerned...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: She seems genuinely concerned...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Oh, what a relief!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Though encircled by my beauty, you
would still
assist in my escape...
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Your utter desire to save me, made
manifest...
You are full of surprises.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
But such a dire undertaking surely
produced dire
consequences. Do you
require rest?
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: Heh-heh. You are kind.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
But, please, allow me to show my
appreciation, at
least for today. Why not
enjoy a peaceful ride on
the Ferris
wheel?
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Though it may be but a fleeting
moment, my
beauty shall be for your
eyes only!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Behold! My exquisite profile, gazing
from the sky
upon the ground!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Opera O strikes pose after pose, yet the
Ferris
wheel car doesn't wobble an inch.
Talk about
inner muscle stability.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
So, you bolted in with your eyes fixed
downward?
Yes, I think that was a sound
judgment.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
An aptitude for split-second
decision-making is a
necessity for
trainers as well.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Hehehe... I must take a lesson from your
actions.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: Thank you, Trainer!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
However, I'm completely at fault for this.
How can
I earn your forgiveness?
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: But I will! For it will not do!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
I've got it! Trainer, follow me—with
haste!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
She takes off running, and I hurriedly
follow, until
I'm led to a boat floating on
the lake.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Hah ha ha! Now, let your eyes feast!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
As I stand aboard this boat, yielding to
the waves'
gentle motion, what results is
an image too
beautiful for even a
painting to capture!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Opera O continues striking pose after
pose as the
boat slowly drifts atop the
water.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The leisurely pace is contrasted with a
rushing
sense of speed... I'm not really
sure how to
describe it.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Her enthusiastic presence is so
captivating I can't
help but ignore the
outside view our ride was
meant to offer.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
